name: Annual Fleabane
desc: Annual Fleabane (Erigeron annuus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Erigeron annuus, the annual fleabane, daisy fleabane, or eastern daisy fleabane, is a species of herbaceous flowering plant, annual or biennial, in the family Asteraceae.
